nodes.label: Epic 9a — Importer Worker Decision Memo
nodes.author: Engineering (drafted by Claude Sonnet 4.6)
nodes.rationale: DECIDED — Inngest. The original draft recommended pg-boss as the lean option, but the confirmed Vercel-Serverless-only hosting constraint eliminated it; the option comparisons are preserved unedited so reviewers can see the reasoning.

nodes.label: Option A — Synchronous commit with a row cap
nodes.rationale: Zero infrastructure and a predictable envelope, but it relocates the problem to the operator for the monthly-seed workflow, does not solve progress reporting, and is a workaround rather than a fix. Viable only as an emergency stopgap.

nodes.label: Option B — pg-boss Postgres-backed queue
nodes.rationale: Transactionally consistent with the application DB and named in the review doc as the lean option, but it requires a persistent worker process which Vercel Serverless cannot host — the constraint that eliminated it.

nodes.label: Option C — Inngest hosted function runner
nodes.rationale: Chosen: no worker process to host, every step runs as a normal Vercel Function inside the 60s budget, native step primitives map onto the row loop, free tier covers the first quarter. Accepted trade-offs are vendor coupling, the callback reachability model and cost at scale.

nodes.label: enqueueImportCommit abstraction boundary
nodes.rationale: The only place Inngest is referenced from app code, so migrating to pg-boss later is a one-file rewrite. Called inside the same prisma.$transaction as the COMMITTING status update, so a failed send rolls the status back and no import gets stuck.

nodes.label: processImportCommit job function
nodes.rationale: The core loop lifted out of the 1083-line route into pure logic with no NextResponse, each phase wrapped in step.run so it gets its own retry policy and state checkpoint.

nodes.label: DISABLE_GOLD_IMPORT_WORKER test fallback
nodes.rationale: In vitest the route runs processImportCommit inline against a stubStep instead of enqueueing, so existing commit tests keep working without change.
